name: DOB-FLY
summary: DOB-FLY, also known as 3C-B-FLY or as B-FLY, is a psychedelic drug and designer drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, DOx, and FLY families. It is the FLY derivative of DOB, the amphetamine (α-methyl) derivative of 2C-B-FLY, and the partially saturated analogue of Bromo-DragonFLY (DOB-DFLY).

uses.text: DOB-FLY, also known as 3C-B-FLY or as B-FLY, is a psychedelic drug and designer drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, DOx, and FLY families. DOB-FLY was developed by David E. Nichols and colleagues at Purdue University.
